description: #73: when pocketsync lands a recording (pocketsync.recording.landed), runs transcribe-file on its audio with the event's audio_path, audio_sha256 and language, into the transcripts_dir variable; the model is the whisper-he actor's. One run per audio at a time (concurrency key stt:<audio_sha256>). Ships disabled: enable it after setting the actor's roots, the grant and the variable (docs/operations/pocket-transcribe.md).
